get.description: Compares the emotional-map identity (schema versions, scoring version, config fingerprints, epochs, flags, environment, release SHA) of this API against the one MAINTAINED BY A LIVE WORKER HEARTBEAT. The worker republishes its identity every 60s under a 180s TTL, so a dead worker — or a deploy that never came up — reports as a MISMATCH rather than silently agreeing from a stale key. An unknown build (missing commit SHA) is also a mismatch: we do not certify what we cannot identify. A mismatch means the cron is writing snapshots this API will refuse to read — run this after every deploy. Names, numbers and booleans only; no secrets.
